review.summary: Single-hunk fix to foreach_plot for Combined plots: previously it always recursed into plot.plots, so atomic/primitive plots with no children were skipped entirely, which is the mechanism behind boundingbox(plot) returning NaN for scatter, lines, mesh, etc. The fix applies f to the plot itself when it has no child plots. Linked issue #2145 and PR #2184 describe exactly this broken existing behavior, and test/boundingboxes.jl covers it.

swe.interface:
Function: boundingbox(plot)
Location: exported from Makie (see src/.../boundingbox.jl)
Inputs: 
- **plot**: a concrete Makie plot object (e.g., result of `mesh`, `surface`, `meshscatter`, `volume`, `scatter`, `lines`, `linesegments`, `heatmap`, `image`, or `text!`). The function must accept any object that implements Makie’s internal `AbstractPlot` interface.
Outputs: 
- Returns a `BoundingBox3D`‑like struct with two fields:
  - `origin::Point3f` – the 3‑D coordinates of the lower‑corner of the axis‑aligned bounding box.
  - `widths::Vec3f` – the extents of the box along the X, Y, and Z axes.
  - The values are in data space for geometric plots and in pixel space for text plots.
Description: 
Computes an axis‑aligned bounding box that encloses all data represented by the given plot. It is used by the tests to verify that the new implementation correctly handles a wide variety of plot types, returning finite, correct origins and sizes instead of NaNs.

llm_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports that `boundingbox(plot)` returns NaN for most plot types and expects it to return correct geometrical bounds. The provided test suite defines explicit expected origins and widths for several atomic plot types, giving clear acceptance criteria. The golden patch fixes a missing case in `foreach_plot` for empty `Combined` plots, directly addressing the cause of the NaN results, and aligns with the tests. No test‑code coupling, naming, external dependencies, or hidden knowledge issues are evident, so the task is solvable as specified.

swe.problem_statement:
`boundingbox(plot)` is broken
Most `boundingbox(plot)` calls just return NaN. This includes:
- mesh
- scatter
- lines
- linesegments
- meshscatter
- volume
- surface
- heatmap
- image

The only one that works is `text`. Though that one currently transforms to pixel space which probably shouldn't happen by default.
swe.test_patch:
diff --git a/test/boundingboxes.jl b/test/boundingboxes.jl
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..57b033b65fc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/boundingboxes.jl
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+@testset "boundingbox(plot)" begin
+    cat = FileIO.load(Makie.assetpath("cat.obj"))
+
+    # Testing atomic plots here. Everything else should be derived from them
+
+    fig, ax, p = mesh(cat)
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(-0.1678, -0.002068, -0.358661)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(0.339423, 0.92186, 1.3318559)
+
+    fig, ax, p = surface([x*y for x in 1:10, y in 1:10])
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(10.0, 10.0, 99.0)
+
+    fig, ax, p = meshscatter([Point3f(x, y, z) for x in 1:5 for y in 1:5 for z in 1:5])
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(1)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(4)
+
+    fig, ax, p = volume(rand(5, 5, 5))
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(5)
+
+    fig, ax, p = scatter(1:10)
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(1, 1, 0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(9, 9, 0)
+
+    fig, ax, p = lines(1:10)
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(1, 1, 0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(9, 9, 0)
+
+    fig, ax, p = linesegments(1:10)
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(1, 1, 0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(9, 9, 0)
+
+    fig, ax, p = heatmap(rand(10, 10))
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(0.5, 0.5, 0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(10.0, 10.0, 0)
+    
+    fig, ax, p = image(rand(10, 10))
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(10.0, 10.0, 0)
+
+    # text transforms to pixel space atm (TODO)
+    fig = Figure(resolution = (400, 400))
+    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1])
+    p = text!(ax, Point2f(10), text = "test")
+    bb = boundingbox(p)
+    @test bb.origin ≈ Point3f(340, 341, 0)
+    @test bb.widths ≈ Vec3f(32.24, 23.3, 0)
+end
\ No newline at end of file
